Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 4 months of right lateral knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Partial tear of the posterior horn/root attachment with multiloculated parameniscal cyst formation at the posterior joint recess measuring 21 x 17 x 8 mm.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Attenuation of the ACL, favored to represent a prior partial tear, with intrasubstance ganglion cyst formation of the proximal attachment.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Partial tear of the posterior root attachment of the medial meniscus with associated parameniscal cyst in the posterior joint recess measuring up to 2.1 cm.
2.	Attenuation of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), favored to represent a prior partial tear.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Alignement articulaire normal. Il y a des signes de dysplasie rotulienne/trochléaire avec une trochlée peu profonde et une facette rotulienne latérale dominante.

Changements dégénératifs :
Chondropatie rétropatellaire modérée avec fissuration profonde de la facette latérale.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Zone focale d’œdème osseux mesurant 1 cm dans la face médiale du condyle fémoral médial, qui semble être en lien avec quelques vaisseaux intra-osseux proéminents. Par ailleurs, l'examen est normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normale.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-latéral et postérieur : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Aucune.

CONCLUSION :
Pas de signes de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.
Chondropatie rétropatellaire modérée avec signes de dysplasie rotulienne/trochléenne sous-jacente. Envisager une consultation orthopédique et une évaluation tomodensitométrique de la distance TT TG.
Petite zone focale d'œdème osseux dans le condyle médial du fémur qui semble en lien avec des structures vasculaires intra-osseuses proéminentes, probablement non significative.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kleine oberflächliche Knorpelirregularität im mittleren Patellafirst (Serie 4/ Image 9). Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complete detached radial tear at the posterior root medial meniscus.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low grade partial thickness cartilage loss at the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Partial thickness cartilage defect at the medial patellar facet. High grade partial thickness cartilage loss at the medial trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal tendinosis without tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complete detached radial tear at the posterior root medial meniscus.
2. Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
3. Mild medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
4. Small joint effusion. Small Baker's cyst.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, appears normal including meniscus and articular cartilage.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at lateral patellar facet (about 1.3*1 cm). There is focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema and intact2 cyst at trochlea (about 1.2* 1.5 cm). The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. 
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. -- Focal low grade chondrosis at lateral patellar facet (about 1.3*1 cm) and focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema and intact2 cyst at lateral trochlea (about 1.2* 1.5 cm).  
 -- Horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
 -- Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar con
la superficie articular. Impresiona un pequeño quiste parameniscal posterior de 2 mm.
Fina úlcera condral focal de espesor total de la región central posterior de platillo tibial lateral, sin cambios
óseos secundarios. Finas úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del
cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones
significativas. Leve displasia troclear.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Discretos cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps
femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Aumento de señal central del cuerpo, cuerno posterior del menisco medial asociado a pequeño quiste
parameniscal posterior. Estos hallazgos podrían representar una pequeña rotura, no desplazada,
correlacionar con clínica.
Condropatía focal grado 3 de la región posterior del platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la región central de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía superficial de la rótula. Leve displasia troclear.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.

Na nativnim MR presjecima kroz desno koljeno vide se umjerene degenerativne promjene
femorotibijalnog zgloba uz honodromalaciju 3. stupnja hrskavice lateralnog i 2. stupnja
medijalnog kondila femura. Izražene degenerativne promjene femoropatelarnog zgloba sa
zonama koštanog edema patele i trohleje femura te denudacijom hrskavice lateralne fasete
patele te hondromalacijom 4. stupnja hrskavice trohleje femura.
Manje zone koštanog edema u području lateralnog kondila femura.
Prednji križni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, promijenjenih intenziteta signala, uz vidljive
sitne ganglion ciste na proksimalnom hvatištu - prvenstveno u sklopu umjerenih degenerativnih
promjena, ddg. ranija parcijalna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni menisk je stanjen, promijenjenih intenziteta signala u području trupa te stražnjeg roga
i korijena, u smislu ranije kompleksne, predominantno horizontalne rupture na podlozi
degenerativnih promjena. Sam menisk je ekstrudiran uz posljedično blagu distenziju medijalnog
kolateralnog ligamenta koji je bez znakova rupture. Od trupa meniska prema kaudalno se prate
parameniscealne ciste ukupnih dimenzija 24 x 15 x 37 mm (APxLLxCC, utiskuju se prema
medijalnom kolateralnom ligamentu i straga prema tetivama pes anserinus.
Degenerativne promjene lateralnog meniska, bez znakova rupture. Prominentan Wrisbergov
ligament.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, entezopatski promijenjenog proksimalnog
hvatišta.
Tendinopatija tetive popliteusa. Primjeren prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tendinopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Patelarni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobu, najizraženije u lateralnom recesusu uz hipertrofiju sinovije
suprapatelarno i posteriorno uz kondile femura.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.
